purpose: Tests the 25-event reading of piece 1, which packet 3 recorded but never tested. Packet 3 treated the colour layer as 24 events (9 yellow + 15 blue) and concluded it carries nothing beyond the URL. That conclusion was too strong: FEFEFE at CCW spiral 164 is a 25th marked cell, and its position is NOT derivable from the URL. This packet tests that marker, plus yellow/blue as positions rather than areas.

defect_found.code: packet/extra_door_pixels.py at commit bb29c5d, function hsv_bucket
defect_found.line: if mn > 220 and mx - mn < 25: return 'white'
defect_found.effect: (254,254,254) and (255,255,255) both return 'white', erasing the FEFEFE cell
defect_found.note: The current palette_bucket and extra_door_find.classify both keep G distinct; the URL decode is unaffected because grey encodes a 0 bit either way.

grey_marker.geometry: exact midpoint of 160 and 168, the LSB cells of characters 20 and 21
grey_marker.why_url_still_validates: character 'n' (0x6E = 01101110) has 0 at MSB-first offset 4, so grey-as-0 decodes correctly

yb_as_positions.note: The pixel counts 50400/83700 are 9 and 15 cells of 5625 px minus edge antialiasing, so they are also URL-derivable. Positions are the non-trivial reading of 'Yellow has a number and so does Blue'.
